name: Yakin Jantou Ni
source:
This time we will play mahjong with the nurses of “Yakin Byoutou Ni”.
Main character is a patient who is introduced a new service one day. If he wins in mahjong, he can humiliate the loser nurse all the way he wants.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这次，我们要和《夜勤病栋·贰》的护士打麻将。
主人公是一名患者，某天有人向他介绍一项新服务。只要麻将获胜，他就可以随心所欲地羞辱败北的护士。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
